text.title: Cohort Implementation Procedure
text.summary: Seven steps from the warehouse to a deployed weekly-cohort model: confirm the users and events tables carry a stable user_id and UTC timestamps, declare engine, retention event and offsets once in settings, write the incremental model with the composite key and 90-day lookback, wire the not_null and accepted_values tests, set the chart spec with the cutoff and null immature cells, backfill and validate, then treat any event change as a new version.

step.name: confirm-sources-and-identity
step.input: The warehouse (BigQuery, Snowflake, Postgres or Redshift); the staging users and events models.
step.action: Record `sources`: `users_table`, `events_table`, `user_id_column: user_id` (identity resolved in staging), `signup_ts_column` and `event_ts_column` as UTC columns. Set `settings.warehouse_engine`, `week_start: monday`, `timezone: UTC` in `templates/cohort-implementation.config.yaml`.
step.output: `sources` and the engine, week and timezone settings.
step.decision-gate: Events carry only `distinct_id` or a device id, or timestamps have no UTC column: fix staging first (06-decision-tree.xml, r-stable-user-id-not-anonymous, r-cohort-key-signup-week-monday-utc).

step.name: declare-the-retention-event-and-offsets-once
step.input: The event that means "came back" for this product; the offsets the team reads.
step.action: Set `settings.retention_event` and `settings.day_offsets` (template: 1, 7, 14, 30, 60, 90). Write the same event into the SQL `WHERE event_type = ...` and into the `schema.yml` model description; set `model.retention_event_declared_in` to sql, schema_yml, settings.
step.decision-gate: The event differs between SQL, schema.yml and settings: the config fails review (r-retention-event-defined-once, r-settings-declare-engine-event-offsets).

step.name: write-the-incremental-model
step.action: Set `model.name`, `materialized: incremental`, `unique_key: [cohort_week, day_offset, user_id]`, `partition_by: cohort_week`, `lookback_days` at least `max(day_offsets)`, `cohort_week_expr` = `DATE_TRUNC(DATE(signup_ts_utc), WEEK(MONDAY))` or the engine's equivalent, `join_condition: event_ts_utc >= signup_ts_utc`, and restrict `day_offset` in the `WHERE` clause to `settings.day_offsets`.
step.decision-gate: Lookback shorter than the largest offset: late day-90 events never land; raise it (r-incremental-key-partition-and-lookback, r-only-events-after-signup-count).

step.name: wire-the-tests
step.action: Set `tests.not_null` to cohort_week, day_offset, user_id and `tests.accepted_values` on `day_offset` to exactly `settings.day_offsets`.
step.decision-gate: An offset exists only in a BI query: it is not in the set and is dropped, never added by editing the dashboard (r-fixed-day-offsets-enforced-by-test).

step.name: set-the-chart-spec-and-denominator
step.input: The data cutoff date; the users table.
step.action: Set `model.denominator_source: users_table` and `chart` with `data_cutoff`, `x: cohort_week`, `series: day_offset`, `metric: retained_users / cohort_users`, `immature_value: null`, `render_immature_as: blank`. A cell is reported only when `cohort_week` + 6 days + `day_offset` is on or before `data_cutoff`.
step.decision-gate: The chart's denominator comes from the model's own rows, or immature cells show 0: fix before publishing (r-denominator-is-full-cohort, r-incomplete-cells-null-not-zero).

step.name: backfill-and-validate
step.input: The model, tests and chart spec; a sample of computed cells.
step.action: Run a full refresh for all historical cohorts, then `dbt test`. Copy a few `cells[]` (a mature cohort at day 90, the newest cohort at day 1 to 30) into the config and run `scripts/validate-cohort-implementation.py --file`.
step.output: Validated config; deployed model with passing tests.
step.decision-gate: A cell has `retained_users` above `cohort_users`, or a cell past the cutoff carries a number: the query or the cutoff is wrong (r-denominator-is-full-cohort, r-incomplete-cells-null-not-zero).

step.name: version-any-change-to-the-event
step.input: A request to change the retention event or the offsets.
step.action: Bump the model version, change the event or offsets in all three places, re-run the full backfill, update `tests.accepted_values.values`, and re-validate. Never edit the live filter in place.
step.output: New model version with a complete history on one definition.
step.decision-gate: An in-place change without backfill is rejected (r-retention-event-defined-once).

list.item: Config validates via `scripts/validate-cohort-implementation.py` with no violation.
`dbt test` passes not_null on the three keys and accepted_values on day_offset.
The chart shows blank cells below the maturity diagonal and no cohort with day-1 retention of 100 percent.
